messages:
Sam (Sales): quick sync — Acme wants a Dedicated POC. their security team will only allow traffic from a single static outbound IP (firewall rule). they also want client cert auth on our callbacks. asking: can we provide static egress IP(s) from a dedicated pool and present a client cert? timeline + any extra costs?

Amal (Eng-Network): short answer: yes for static egress IPs from a Dedicated pool. we can reserve 1-3 SNAT EIPs and ensure all outbound calls from that pool egress via those IPs.

Amal (Eng-Network): client certs for outbound (mutual TLS) is trickier — we can terminate TLS and present a client cert from our side if the customer trusts our CA, but that requires either:
- Private deployment (recommended) for full cert/HSM control, or
- Dedicated with an ops change where we inject a managed client cert per-customer (operational overhead + justification).

Jess (Solutions): customer asked for timeline: if they accept 3 IPs and no mTLS it's ~48-72 hrs to provision + provide IPs and firewall ARNs. if they need mTLS we'll need security signoff and likely 1-2 weeks (depends on cert distribution). also FYI we bill static EIPs as an add-on on top of Dedicated monthly commit.

Nate (Infra): tech details: for Dedicated pools we do SNAT from the pool's NAT gateway. sample allowed list we can hand to customers:

```
203.0.113.45
203.0.113.46
203.0.113.47
```

Nate (Infra): IPs above are examples. real IPs will be allocated per-region. we can pin pool to a specific region/az if the customer firewall depends on source geo.

Maya (Security): a couple of security notes:
- we will produce TLS server cert validation for inbound callbacks as usual.
- for mTLS outbound we need a private key escrow strategy; Private deployment + KMS/HSM integration is the cleanest.
- audit logs: we can enable per-request audit logging for the POC for their compliance team.

Sam (Sales): pricing question for customer: what should I tell them re extra cost per static IP and per-client-cert support?

Jess (Solutions): rough numbers (ballpark) — static EIP reservation: $200/mo per IP on top of Dedicated commit; managed client-cert support: one-time onboarding fee $3k + $500/mo ops for cert rotation if we manage keys. mark as estimate until PM confirms.

Amal (Eng-Network): fallback option if they refuse static IPs: use a short-lived connector where customer pulls from our private endpoint via an outbound VPN or SFTP; or they can allow a CIDR block we control (3 /29s) for rotation. both increase ops complexity and may affect latency.

OpsBot: provisioning_request created: PR-7892 — Dedicated pool allocation (region: us-west-2) — owner: Nate. ETA: 72 hours.

Sam (Sales): action items: 1) Sam to confirm whether Acme needs exactly 1 IP or tolerates 3 for rotation. 2) Acme to confirm if they require mTLS. 3) Nate to respond with final quote and exact IPs once provisioning is complete.

Maya (Security): also ask Acme to fill out the short security checklist (links): https://redwood.example.com/poc-security-checklist (just the minimal fields: allowed IPs, required ciphers, mTLS yes/no).

Sam (Sales): noted. looping in customer tomorrow after lunch. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
